signQuality.aries: It sounds direct and energetic: you want to begin and try first.
signQuality.taurus: It sounds unhurried and grounded: reliability, comfort and the body matter.
signQuality.gemini: It sounds lively and curious: you enjoy learning, comparing and exchanging.
signQuality.cancer: It sounds soft and attuned: closeness, safety and care matter.
signQuality.leo: It sounds warm and bright: you want to create, be seen and share joy.
signQuality.virgo: It sounds attentive and practical: details, usefulness and order matter.
signQuality.libra: It sounds harmonious: you seek balance, agreement and beauty in relationships.
signQuality.scorpio: It sounds deep and focused: honesty, intimacy and change matter.
signQuality.sagittarius: It sounds open and inspired: you are drawn to meaning, freedom and far horizons.
signQuality.capricorn: It sounds composed and patient: goals, responsibility and step-by-step progress matter.
signQuality.aquarius: It sounds independent and original: freedom, ideas and honesty with yourself are valued.
signQuality.pisces: It sounds sensitive and imaginative: lots of fantasy, compassion and intuition.

pair.fire-fire.gives: Two fires inspire each other quickly: lots of energy, bold plans and shared excitement.
pair.fire-fire.learn: Keep the heat from turning into rivalry, and leave room for pauses and quiet.
pair.fire-earth.gives: Fire brings the idea and momentum, earth brings support and the knack of finishing things.
pair.fire-earth.learn: Fire can respect a slower pace, earth can avoid dampening the spark. Then ideas take shape.
pair.fire-air.gives: Air fans the fire: it is easy to talk, invent and pick up each other's ideas.
pair.fire-air.learn: Remember feelings and everyday matters — they sometimes stay in the shadows of enthusiasm.
pair.fire-water.gives: Fire warms water and water softens fire: you can get both warmth and depth.
pair.fire-water.learn: Feelings move at different speeds: fire can avoid rushing, water can speak about feelings directly.
pair.earth-earth.gives: A calm pair with shared values: reliability, comfort and a habit of moving step by step.
pair.earth-earth.learn: Add lightness and novelty so that stability does not turn into routine.
pair.earth-air.gives: Earth gives air some ground, air brings earth fresh ideas and conversation.
pair.earth-air.learn: Earth can avoid hasty conclusions, air can lean more on concrete deeds.
pair.earth-water.gives: Water nourishes earth and earth gives water its banks: a combination about care and closeness.
pair.earth-water.learn: Do not retreat into comfort alone — say aloud what worries you.
pair.air-air.gives: Plenty of conversation, curiosity and lightness: it is interesting both to talk and to be silent together.
pair.air-air.learn: Notice emotions behind the talk and do not postpone the important for "later".
pair.air-water.gives: Air helps put feelings into words, water hints at what stands behind the words.
pair.air-water.learn: Find a shared language: air can be more tuned in, water can avoid hiding in a mood.
pair.water-water.gives: Deep understanding without extra words: much sensitivity, care and shared intuition.
pair.water-water.learn: Do not dissolve into each other's moods, and keep your own boundaries.
modalityPair.cardinal-cardinal: You both love to begin: shared projects launch easily, though it helps to agree who leads.
modalityPair.cardinal-fixed: One sets the impulse, the other holds the course: you complement each other well.
modalityPair.cardinal-mutable: One offers direction, the other adapts flexibly: it is easy to find a shared pace.
modalityPair.fixed-fixed: You are both steady and loyal to your own: reliable, but yielding can be hard — humor and pauses help.
modalityPair.fixed-mutable: Steadiness meets flexibility: one gives support, the other lightness in change.
modalityPair.mutable-mutable: You are both adaptable and open to change: fun together, but it helps to agree on a familiar rhythm.
